_comment: Public datasets for the C Spire retail video POC. 'access' tells download.py how to fetch each one. Sizes are approximate. Licences were checked Sept 2026 - re-check before any commercial use.

datasets.name: MOT17 (MOTChallenge)
datasets.notes: 7 train sequences with GT (x3 detector variants). Test GT is hidden (server only). Includes MOT17-04/-09 pedestrian scenes; use train split for local eval.

datasets.name: MOT20 (MOTChallenge, crowded)
datasets.notes: 4 train sequences with GT; very dense crowds - stress test for peak hours.

datasets.name: CAVIAR shopping centre (Lisbon)
datasets.licence: Free for research; acknowledge EC-funded CAVIAR project IST 2001 37540
datasets.notes: 384x288 @ 25fps. XML GT has per-person role/situation (browsing, shop enter/exit, walking) - our only real-video check for stop-vs-pass and shop entry counting. 'front' views also exist; add them to 'sequences' if needed.

datasets.name: PersonPath22 (Amazon)
datasets.notes: Needs aws cli + ffmpeg. Annotations at 5 fps key frames. Converter to MOT format is 'to appear' upstream - use gluoncv motion format loader.

datasets.name: NVIDIA PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces (AI City 2025 Track 1)
datasets.notes: Synthetic, 1080p30 - downscale to 640x360@15. Default pulls annotations + maps only (small); add --with-videos for MP4s. NEVER pull depth maps (~3 TB). Retail-like scenes: run 'download.py list-files smartspaces' and look for Retail/Store scene names; 2024 edition README mentions retail spaces in scenes 071-080.

datasets.name: MEVA (Multiview Extended Video with Activities)
datasets.notes: Huge. download.py only lists the bucket by default; pass --prefix to sync one folder. Activity annotations live in the MEVA data repo on GitLab (Kitware).

datasets.name: MERL Shopping
datasets.licence: Not stated - confirm with MERL before use
datasets.notes: 106 overhead clips (~2 min) with shopper action labels incl. Inspect Shelf.

datasets.name: RetailAction (Standard AI)
datasets.notes: Item-level interactions (out of POC scope) - only for VLM description tests. Read LICENSE before downloading videos.

datasets.name: Market-1501
datasets.licence: Research use; cite Zheng et al. ICCV 2015
datasets.notes: The mirror server is third-party and sometimes down - use the Google Drive link from the official project page if it fails.

datasets.name: MSMT17
datasets.notes: Sign the PDF agreement (institution signature), email it, receive a link. Unzip into <root>/msmt17/.

datasets.name: MMPTRACK (Microsoft, ICCV 2021 MMP workshop)
datasets.agreement: Terms & conditions document on the dataset page; email to iccv2021mmp@outlook.com
datasets.notes: Closest match to C Spire: retail room, 640x320 @ 15 fps, overlapping cameras, per-camera boxes + world footpoints. Request access FIRST - it takes days.
